issues.legal_issue: The omission to file an application explaining delay along with a time-barred appeal is a curable defect when the application is filed before the appeal is rejected.
material_facts: An appeal from an appellate decree was filed after the limitation period had expired without an accompanying application to explain the delay.
The appellant later filed an application to condone the delay before the appeal was rejected.
The High Court dismissed the appeal solely because the application had not accompanied it when first presented.
issues.conclusion: The omission was not fatal. The later application could be considered with the appeal, and the matter was remitted for the court to decide whether the explanation for delay was satisfactory.
issues.legal_principle: Order 42 Rule 1 makes the relevant rules in Order 41 applicable to appeals from appellate decrees. Order 41 Rule 3A(1) requires a time-barred appeal to be accompanied by an application supported by an affidavit setting out the grounds for condoning delay; Rule 3A(2) requires that application to be decided before the court proceeds to deal with the appeal. The requirement is an obligation, but its breach is a curable defect, not an irredeemably fatal one. The court relied on the purposes of Rule 3A and the principles concerning statutory construction in Crawford on Statutory Construction, approved in Govind Lal Chaggan Lal Patel v. Agriculture Produce Market Committee, and defective appeal presentation in Jagat Dhish Bhargava v. Jawahar Lal Bhargava; it also referred to State of Karnataka v. Nagappa.

rule.if: appeal_from_appellate_decree and appeal_filed_after_limitation and no_delay_application_at_presentation and delay_application_filed_before_appeal_rejected

predicates.appeal_from_appellate_decree: The appellant filed an appeal challenging a decree made in an earlier appeal.
predicates.appeal_filed_after_limitation: The appellant filed the appeal after the period allowed for filing it had expired.
predicates.no_delay_application_at_presentation: The appellant did not submit an application explaining the delay when the appeal was first presented.
predicates.delay_application_filed_before_appeal_re: The appellant submitted an application explaining the delay before the court rejected the appeal.

issues.definition: When an appeal from an appellate decree is filed late without an accompanying explanation for the delay, filing that explanation before the appeal is rejected can cure the defective presentation.
